migration-v7.description: Rewrite the v6 entry-points consolidated in v7: wr-autocomplete/chips-input → wr-select; wr-time-picker/date-time-picker → wr-date-picker; wr-tooltip → wr-popover; wr-tree-select → wr-tree; wr-bottom-sheet → wr-drawer; wr-count-up(-text) → wr-counter; ngwr/tag → ngwr/badge; wr-image → wr-lightbox; wr-animated-text → wr-typewriter/wr-decrypt-text/wr-split-text (per mode). Touches .html, .ts, and .scss files.

migration-v8.description: Rename density values compact/default/comfortable → sm/md/lg (wrDensity, provideWrDensity defaultDensity, [data-wr-density]); pagination size xs/xl → sm/lg. Warns about removed APIs (WrReveal directive, WrScrambleText / ngwr/scramble-text) that need manual migration. Touches .html, .ts, and .scss files.

migration-v9.description: Rename the <wr-checkbox> group-membership input value → checkboxValue (also [value] / [(value)]). The standalone checkbox is now a signal-forms FormCheckboxControl whose contract reserves `value` for the form value — its boolean state is the `checked` model. Touches .html and .ts files.

migration-v12.description: Move the date entry points under one namespace: ngwr/date-adapter → ngwr/date, ngwr/date-adapter-fns → ngwr/date/adapters/fns, ngwr/date-adapter-luxon → ngwr/date/adapters/luxon. Import paths only — every exported symbol keeps its name. Touches .ts, .html and .json files.

migration-v13.description: Reports every host-id selector on <wr-checkbox>, <wr-radio> and <wr-switch>: `[id]` no longer lands on the host element, it goes to the inner <input> where the input was always documented to put it. Rewrites nothing — whether `wr-checkbox#agree` should become `#agree` (the tick), `wr-checkbox:has(#agree)` (the row) or a class is a decision only the author can make, and a selector that stops matching is silent in CSS, in querySelector and in a test locator alike. Reads .ts, .html, .scss and .css files.

migration-v14.description: Rewrites six renames: on <wr-alert> from closeable to closable; on <wr-table> from totalItems to total; on <wr-pagination> from currentPage to page (and from currentPageChange to pageChange); from isDisabledWhenLoading to disabledWhenLoading; the window chromeSize scale from compact/normal to sm/md, including the .wr-window--chrome-compact class; and on [wrInput] from wrSize to size. Reports what a codemod cannot decide: router integration is now opt-in (<wr-loading-bar> needs provideWrLoadingBarRouter() from ngwr/loading-bar/router, <wr-tab routerLink> needs wrTabsRouting on the strip plus WrTabsRouting in imports), the locale defaults now follow LOCALE_ID, and <wr-pagination ofLabel> is gone. Touches .ts, .html, .scss and .css files.

migration-v15.description: Rewrites what means the same in its new place: the seven chart paths from ngwr/<name> to ngwr/charts/<name> and the twenty-one bit paths to ngwr/bits/<name>, ngwr/drag-drop to ngwr/sortable-list and ngwr/icon/adapters/lucide to ngwr/icon (TypeScript, @use, /testing and JSON); provideWrDensity(), provideWrToastConfig(), provideWrStorage(), provideWrMeta(), provideWrDateAdapter() and provideWrTheme() in a providers array into one provideWr(...) call with withDensity(), withToast(), withStorage(), withMeta(), withDates() and withTheme(), imports included (a bare provideWrDateAdapter() is deleted); rgba(var(--wr-color-<name>-rgb), a) to color-mix(in srgb, var(--wr-color-<name>) a%, transparent); the neutral token reads --wr-color-light and --wr-color-outline to --wr-border-base, --wr-color-border* to --wr-border-subtle, --wr-color-dark and --wr-color-white-contrast to --wr-color-on-surface, --wr-color-medium and --wr-color-muted-text to --wr-color-on-surface-muted; [wrTypography] tone dark/medium to base/muted and <wr-timeline-item color="medium"> to neutral, with their classes. Reports, by file and line, what needs a decision: @use 'ngwr', a density setting with no density sheet, a removed intent (secondary, light, medium, dark) as a colour, class, token, shade or $base-colors key, [data-theme] and theme.dark, a -rgb read or a removed token declaration it could not rewrite, a provider call it could not move, provideWrOverlay (delete it), ngwr/config, ngwr/media, the responsive bottom sheets, ngwr/markdown and <wr-editor format>, ngwr/action-sheet, ngwr/squircle, <wr-drawer showHandle>, the date-fns, Luxon and Feather adapters, the sortable list's loop, provideWrFormErrors and the validation copy ngwr no longer ships, the sidebar's new shape and the keyboard inset. Touches .ts, .html, .scss, .sass, .css and .json files.

migration-v16.description: Renames the functions, constants and types that v16 gave the library prefix, as imports from ngwr/utils, ngwr/color-picker, ngwr/icon, ngwr/date, ngwr/hotkey, ngwr/i18n, ngwr/storage, ngwr/toast and ngwr/charts/core and at every use of the binding in the file: a function takes wr and a capital (clamp to wrClamp, isDefined to wrIsDefined, lucideIcons to wrLucideIcons), a constant WR_ (KEYS to WR_KEYS, CHART_PALETTE to WR_CHART_PALETTE, DEFAULT_TOAST_CONFIG to DEFAULT_WR_TOAST_CONFIG), a type Wr (Maybe to WrMaybe). An aliased import keeps its alias, a re-export and a shorthand property keep the app's own name, and a namespace member (utils.clamp) is renamed too. Uses are matched by binding, so a same-named identifier that is not the ngwr import (debounce from rxjs, a local clamp) is left alone. Renames the inputs and options that changed name, each only where the place says whose it is: showLabel to showValue on <wr-slider>, showLabel and hideLabel to showPasswordLabel and hidePasswordLabel on <wr-password-toggle> (the attribute and the binding, in templates and inline templates), and the toast option dismissible to closable in the argument of show() on a WrToast and in an object typed as WrToastOptions. Reports, by file and line, an import of ngwr/animations/core, which is no longer an entry point, a mock factory or dynamic import() of an entry point with renamed exports, a dismissible it could not place in a file that uses the toast, and isOpen.set() or isOpen.update() on a popover or a dropdown, whose isOpen is read-only now (call open() or close()). Touches .ts and .html files.
